personality_one_liner: A quiet, cinematic space where traditional Indian craft meets global contemporary minimalism.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like breathing room. Use xl/2xl between distinct editorial sections. Keep padding deliberate. Avoid dense clutter.

do's: Use solid surface or surfaceSecondary instead of glassmorphism, staying true to the Editorial personality.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrims exclusively behind text on images for readability.
dont's: Do not use blur or frosted glass; the brand demands a matte, natural, tactile editorial feel without digital synthetic effects.

screens.name: Home / Discover
screens.purpose: A cinematic entry introducing the brand's aesthetic and leading into the core journey.

states.loading: Subtle minimal skeleton loader with a central hairline spinner.
states.error: Elegant text message 'Unable to load catalogue.' with a quiet retry text button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed cinematic hero image occupying 75% of the viewport. Apply a gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) at the bottom. Elegant serif headline layered over the scrim. Below the fold, present the 'Design DNA Questionnaire' as a standalone editorial card with generous padding.

screens.name: Design DNA Questionnaire
screens.purpose: Help the user find their aesthetic through 5 highly visual swipe questions.

states.loading: Spinner centered on a pure surface canvas.
states.error: Error loading questionnaire with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen interactive flow. Top header with a minimal hairline progress bar. Question in serif centered at the top. The rest of the screen is a swipeable image card stack (Tinder-like but elegant) with a 'Yes/No' or 'Choose A/Choose B' interaction model. Minimalist labels.

screens.name: Jacket Discovery Catalogue
screens.purpose: Browse the collection of reversible quilted jackets.

states.empty: No jackets match your filters. Try clearing them.

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with horizontally scrolling minimal filter chips (pill radius, outlined or solid surfaceTertiary). Below, a 2-column grid for products. High-aspect-ratio (4:5) images. Below each image: product name in sans-serif base size, price in dual currency (₹ and $) separated by a dot.

screens.name: Product Page (PDP)
screens.purpose: Deep dive into the hero product, exploring the craft story and initiating customization.

states.loading: Full bleed skeleton loader for image, linear skeletons for text.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge swipeable gallery at the top. Title in elegant serif, dual pricing. An 'AI Design Moment' section presented as a magazine quote block. Expandable accordion lists for 'Product Passport' and specs. Sticky bottom CTA ('Customise in The Atelier') pinned in a white bottom container.

screens.name: The Atelier (Customisation)
screens.purpose: Interactive studio to customize silhouette, quilt, colour, and craft intensity with a live preview.
screens.layout: Top 60% of screen: Large image of the jacket updating in real-time. Bottom 40%: A horizontal scrolling category selector (Silhouette, Quilt, Colour, Craft Intensity) sitting directly above a horizontally scrolling list of circular or square texture swatches. Live pricing updates on the sticky bottom edge. The 'Made-ability compatibility meter' is rendered as a minimal horizontal progress line under the jacket image.

screens.name: Craft Story (Audio Player)
screens.purpose: Listen to the artisan's journey behind the quilt pattern.

states.empty: No story available for this piece.

screens.layout: Minimalist overlay or dedicated modal. A large portrait of the artisan or a macro texture shot. A singular play/pause button (Feather icon). A thin hairline horizontal scrubber for the timeline. Typographic emphasis on the artisan's name in serif.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) and 'Satoshi' (sans-serif) fonts explicitly via expo-font. Do not use generic system fonts or google-fonts wrappers.
Implement the 'Editorial Mobile LIGHT' aesthetics. Preserve high contrast: use pure ink black against porcelain warm white.
Ensure generous xl/2xl vertical padding between layout sections to mimic a high-end fashion magazine layout.
Avoid glassmorphism completely. Instead, rely on solid backgrounds, hairline dividers, and stark negative space.
Whenever overlaying text on images (like the Home Hero), apply a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim using expo-linear-gradient (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to ensure text legibility.
Render all prices explicitly in both currencies with a subtle separator, e.g., '₹ 12,500 • $ 150'. Use sans-serif for numbers to maintain readability.
For the Made-ability compatibility meter, build a minimal un-styled horizontal line (1px-2px height) or a sophisticated minimal scale rather than a generic tech progress bar.
All navigation should be stack-only (linear flow) per the luxury/editorial preference, to avoid clutter from a persistent tab bar.
Avoid rounded, bubbly corners. Stick to the provided radius tokens (sm:0, md:4, lg:8) to keep the layout feeling sharp and premium.
In the Atelier screen, implement a two-pane layout: a large jacket visual at the top half, and horizontal scrolling selector tabs (Silhouette, Quilt, Colour) at the bottom half.
